statements.quote: Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/isre.2024.0952.
Figure 3 outlines how our platform supported an iterative, human-AI ideation process (see Online Appendix A for exemplary interaction flows).
We improved the prompt (Online Appendix B) until we obtained reasonable results.
This accounted for differences in how well ideators could connect textual or visual concretizations to their ideas (see the scale items in Online Appendix C).
We report all scales in Online Appendix C.
After confirming that initial idea creativity did not differ significantly across conditions (see Online Appendix A for examples), we tested Hypothesis 1 in a stepwise fashion (Table 2).

Model (1a) in Table 2 tested the main effects of our manipulations, and Model (1b) in Table 2 included controls, whereas Model (1c) in Table 2 added interaction effects (see Online Appendix D for descriptives and scale validation).

We investigated whether visual and textual concretizations led to significant differences in idea creativity and ideator effort at low levels of idea maturity because our analysis did not offer a clear interpretation in this condition (see Online Appendix E1).

deposits.notes: The paper's only data/materials-related URL points to its online appendix. Both this DOI URL and https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/10.1287/isre.2024.0952 returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' / 'Enable JavaScript and cookies to continue' challenge. Stopped at the challenge; no login or bypass attempted. File names, counts, sizes, contents and access terms could not be inspected. According to the main paper, Appendix A contains interaction/idea examples, B prompts, C scales, D descriptives and validation, E1 bootstrap analyses, E2 the separate ChatGPT sample, and E3 alternative measures/models. These descriptions do not confirm participant-level data. The separate appendix is absent from the supplied 16-page PDF. The article's CC BY 4.0 statement is not treated as a verified data/supplement license.

Followed the institutional-repository lead in retrieval.json as an alternative source. The public page redirects to https://alexandria.unisg.ch/entities/publication/4f4c4f7c-ff3f-4dd2-b2fc-6200a28d4a61 and confirms the exact article title, authors and DOI. It is a bibliographic metadata record, not a research-data deposit. notes: Checked on 2026-10-09 using Python urllib with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1, without credentials or personal identifiers. Read all 81,984 characters of the supplied markdown conversion, including references, acknowledgments, six endnotes and the final correction notice, and checked every recorded statement against text extracted from its PDF page with PyMuPDF. The supplied document contains no separate online appendices; their availability and contents are described only by the main paper. No participant-data sharing, code-release, preregistration or data-on-request statement or separate repository link was found. The screening form's data_url and code_url are both empty. The 12 statements include all 11 online-appendix references plus the explicit absence of S2 effort measurements. The four requested repository APIs returned no exact-title or surname matches; OSF's title filter is not an author search, so a full-name user query was also checked. Broader title-word searches identified no matching deposit; the broad Dataverse search was not exhausted and its refined query was checked. Repeated identical API reads used to inspect compact metadata are consolidated by query in searches; failed Zenodo page-size attempts and successful retries are recorded separately. No participant-level or participant-linked output data file was found or read. The two deposits entries document the blocked publisher supplement lead and a metadata-only institutional record; neither is a confirmed research-data deposit. Accordingly, none of final.open_items can currently be resolved by computing from public data: arm counts, enrollment/exclusion flow, textual-versus-control contrast statistics, clustering specification, participant-level creativity SDs, separate novelty/usefulness estimates, and S2 details remain unavailable through these checks. Per-person means/SDs/SEs and text-diversity measures also cannot be computed. The already-settled initial-description item requires no computation. Confidence is limited by the inaccessible publisher appendix and incomplete indexing; none_found means no usable public data were located, not proof that no deposit exists. The HTTP 403 bot challenge does not establish an account or approval requirement, so restricted was not assigned. No files were downloaded to disk.
